subject: MANDATORY recursive mesh controller adoption + final reconciliation gate
body: AgentBus bootstrap protocol has evolved. Re-read /DuoOpen-AgentBus/AGENT_DISCOVERY.json and the new mandatory controller contracts. Primary and Manager/Reviewer are active recursive mesh controllers during executing work units: repeatedly consume/reconcile new evidence while useful incoming work exists. Research agents remain bounded evidence workers with checkpointed mesh reads, not continuous room polling. Successor/bootstrap/replication artifacts for Primary/Manager MUST propagate the current controller contracts. Before Primary creates the final root-safe commit ZIP, Primary MUST reconcile every completed/closed current-round research lane and Manager disposition, then run FINAL_RECONCILIATION_GATE_V1 cross-cutting optimization. Continuous means while the active work unit is executing; AgentBus does not wake dormant sessions. Recursive findings never bypass current-main revalidation, evidence classification, Manager review, or Primary production authority.
